LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE:

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are you doing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify sentences featuring future continuous tense in print and digital texts
2. use future continuous tense in oral and written contexts correctly

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:

Teach
• Focus skill: identify sentences featuring future continuous tense in print and digital texts.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense:
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are you doing?
2. What were you doing yesterday?
3. What will you be doing tomorrow?
4. How do you show an action will take place tomorrow or at a later time?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
